messages:
Sasha: Ugh... space heater kicked my breaker during standup and the building's fiber went dark. I'm on an ancient 4G hotspot. Pics: https://imgur.com/a/abcd123
Ben: Yikes. you ok? need someone to pick up groceries or heater? :grimacing:
Sasha: All good! Heater is fine, just circuit overload. Was mid-demo so audio was... crunchy.
NetBot: [Alert] CityGrid fiber maintenance detected in NW block. Estimated restore in ~35m. https://status.citygrid.example
Amy: That happened to me last winter. Temporary fix: run ethernet from neighbor if they're cool with it, or tether from a second phone.
Josh: If you want a quick audio workaround, record locally and upload after — much less jitter on calls.
Maria: Pro tip: if you're on mac, increase TCP keepalive: ```sudo sysctl -w net.inet.tcp.keepidle=300``` helped me on spotty LTE.
Sasha: Thanks @Maria and @Josh — currently doing local recording + switching mic to offline mode. Hotspot latency ~250ms but it's surviving.
Ben: If you need a desk swap, my spare ethernet runs under the stairwell. Or come to the office for a few hrs, door's open. :door:
Sasha: Appreciate it! Might swing by later. For now, here's the glorious result — space heater photobomb + my cat named Protocol. https://imgur.com/a/efgh456
Amy: Protocol looks unimpressed. :smile_cat:
Josh: 10/10 for resourcefulness. Also love the heating rig behind you. :hotsprings:
Maria: Saved the demo clip btw? We can stitch it into the recording if needed.
Sasha: Yep saved. Will upload in 10. If fiber is still down, I'll post in #support for a backup deployment plan.
NetBot: [Info] Reminder: submit an incident only if customer-facing systems are impacted. Otherwise post in #eng-infra.
Ben: Also, for future lazy-proofing, a UPS + small PoE switch keeps things sane during blips.
Sasha: Note to self: buy UPS, shower cat with treats. :laughing:
